paragraphs.text: The Kodama of the Center Tree is a kami of the Tree of All Seasons in the Jukai on Kamigawa .

The Kodama of the Center Tree is the kami of the Tree of All Seasons in the Jukai forest, one of the Five Trees . It is the oldest of the Tree kami and thus it values history above all else. It is said to know more than anyone else in the forest but paradoxically is impossible to find and talk to.
